chapter.title: Wet Floor. Dry Humor.
chapter.subtitle: The quietest employee ends the loudest rematch.
chapter.description: The quietest employee ends the loudest rematch. Watch the film, work the shift, solve the House puzzle, and win a fade against the red and blue crews.

tips: The center district locks for both crews in round three; use the outside districts.
Cards already in the center still contribute; the lock stops later entry.
Janitor has a separate charge for harmful Hands or status effects and forced staff moves in its district each round.
Round 1: Janitor joins your hand. Round 2: Squabble House Manager joins your hand. These are temporary copies for this battle; pay their normal Motion costs to play them.

scenes.text: Floor got a personal problem with me.

scenes.speaker: Mop
scenes.text: Y’all tied. Congratulations. The plate still needs a dry route to the pass.

scenes.speaker: Manager
scenes.text: Follow the marked tiles. We are running out of dignity, not towels.

scenes.speaker: Mop
scenes.text: Door A1 to pass D3. No diagonals, no wet squares, no improvising.

scenes.speaker: Cuff
scenes.text: That last rule was for both of you.

puzzle.title: Respect the Wet Floor
puzzle.instruction: Trace the dry route from A1 (front door) to D3 (service pass). Columns A–D go left to right; rows 1–3 go from the windows toward the counter. Step one square horizontally or vertically. No diagonals. Use every dry tile once; all unlisted squares are wet.

pieces.label: C3 · turn at the cone
pieces.detail: Dry square C3. The service pass is one square to the right.

pieces.label: B1 · window mat
pieces.detail: Dry square B1. A1 is one square left; B2 is one square toward the counter.

pieces.label: C2 · aisle mat
pieces.detail: Dry square C2. B2 is one square left; C3 is one square toward the counter.

pieces.label: B2 · booth corner
pieces.detail: Dry square B2. B1 is one square toward the windows; C2 is one square right.

hints: From A1, only B1 is a listed horizontal or vertical neighbor. Follow the dry squares, not the diagonal shortcuts.
A1 → B1 → B2 → C2 → C3 → D3. Right, toward counter, right, toward counter, right.
puzzle.solvedText: Plate delivered. Shoes dry. Red and Blue’s diagonal shortcut was not on the map—and neither was their landing.
puzzle.skipText: Let the crew explain the solution. The next fade still has to be won to earn its reward.
